title: me-qfactor-budget: per-channel energy-loss budget predicting the quality factor of magnetoelectric laminate composites
description: Companion code for the manuscript 'A per-channel energy-loss budget predicts the quality factor of magnetoelectric laminate composites without structural fitting' (submitted to Smart Materials and Structures, 2026). Self-contained Python scripts (numpy, matplotlib): five-channel loss budget with exactly computed demagnetizing flux factor, stress-driven Rayleigh hysteresis with self-consistent amplitude-dependent Q, interval brackets, inverse bounds, and an automated verification suite.
